Optional readiness diagnostic (not yet answered)

These are optional bridges, not a test or a claim about mastery.

  1. Given a duplicate-detection loop, state its invariant and count its work.
  2. Calculate a conditional probability from a small contingency table.
  3. Multiply a small matrix by a vector and explain the output shape.
  4. Explain why a benchmark with more successes can still be a worse comparison.

If needed, add a short bridge in sets/induction, algebra/fractions, probability, or derivatives to the affected pack. No answer is required to produce the sequence.

Continuity rules

  • An item becomes produced only after its required files have been saved in durable storage.
  • A repair or missing prerequisite takes precedence over a later queued item.
  • Index states describe artifacts, never learner mastery.
  • Detailed evidence is kept in each pack; SDE_SOURCES.md tracks source identity and access boundaries.
